intent: Wrap markdown links in OSC 8 hyperlink sequences so they are clickable and copy-pasteable even when they wrap across multiple terminal lines.
Add OSC 8 hyperlink URL tracking to AnsiCodeTracker so wrapTextWithAnsi re-opens hyperlinks on continuation lines when a link wraps across multiple terminal lines.
Clear OSC 8 hyperlink state when AnsiCodeTracker is reset.
Include OSC 8 hyperlink opener in getActiveCodes() so wrapped lines re-open the clickable link.
Include OSC 8 hyperlink in hasActiveCodes() check so the tracker knows there is active state to restore.
Wrap URLs inside inline code spans (`url`) with OSC 8 so they are clickable even when they wrap across terminal lines.
Wrap the changelog URL in the update notification banner with OSC 8 so it is clickable even when wrapped across lines.
replace: const changelogRawUrl = "https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/CHANGELOG.md"; const changelogUrl = `\x1b]8;;${changelogRawUrl}\x07` + theme.fg("accent", changelogRawUrl) + `\x1b]8;;\x07`;
